claimsToVerify: Versions of the Teniente Gimo aswang tale circulate across Panay, including Aklan and Iloilo, where the intended victim is a young woman visiting for a fiesta
Teniente del barrio was the Spanish-colonial title for a village lieutenant, the local official of a barrio
In the classic telling, Gimo's intended victim escapes by switching sleeping places with Gimo's own daughter, whom the family strikes in the dark by mistake
